title: Chemical potential of a gas
caption: For an ideal gas μ = μ° + RT ln(p/p°): the chemical potential rises with pressure, logarithmically. At the standard pressure (1 bar) μ = μ°; matter flows from high μ to low.
alt: μ − μ° against pressure in bar at 298 K: a logarithmic curve through zero at 1 bar.
description: Below 1 bar, μ is below μ°.
Above 1 bar, μ rises ever more slowly: RT ln p.

checks.name: μ = μ° at the standard pressure
RT ln e = RT = 2.48 kJ mol⁻¹ at 298 K
